latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Steam Gaming Companion — full Steam Web API integration for library management, recommendations, and more.

- Manage your Steam game library with unplayed, abandoned, and played categorizations.
- Get smart play recommendations by mood (chill, intense, story-driven, competitive) and available playtime.
- Monitor your Steam wishlist for games currently on sale.
- Track and display progress on game achievements.
- Look up details, ratings, and genres for any game in your library or wishlist.
- Simple setup with required Steam API credentials, plus optional IGDB integration for richer game info.
